comparison.objective: Aim a loaded inspection arm to +15 degrees and lock it there.
comparison.physical_skill: One gripper supports a loaded articulated arm while the other tightens an indexed clamp; then both withdraw.
comparison.success_condition: Arm retains the set elevation for two seconds after release; locking before aiming fails.
comparison.reason: This is the closest adjustment-and-lock task, but it tests simultaneous support and clamp tightening at a prescribed angle. The candidate adds recessed-bit insertion, captive-screw loosening, bit withdrawal, collar rotation, moved-socket reacquisition, guarded cycling, and iterative response-based setting. The record lacks a full spec, but its stated mechanism and outcome still establish a meaningful distinction.
